desc: Derive the sweep invariant: for each right endpoint `r`, valid starts are exactly `maxLeft + 1 ... r`.
Group normalized pairs by their larger endpoint so all constraints introduced at each sweep position can be processed efficiently.
Implement global maximum restriction, its occurrence multiplicity/unique owner, and the best strictly lower restriction.
Accumulate baseline valid-subarray counts and per-pair gains when a pair uniquely determines the current maximum.
Verify implementation against examples, duplicate pairs, same-left distinct pairs, and pairs introduced at the same endpoint.
